research_contract.target: Use unopened pinned official result files to test fixed outcome-free Selectors across repository-local rolling Origins without a paid LLM call.
research_contract.primary_baseline: all eligible historical Tasks from the same repository
research_contract.primary_loss: mean across the frozen public Agent panel of absolute selected-history versus future-cohort pass-rate error
research_contract.primary_estimand: repository-equal mean of per-repository mean candidate-minus-full-history loss
required_evidence: all selected result blobs match their preregistered Git blob SHA
every result normalizes against the exact 500-task dataset denominator
per-repository, macro-repository, cluster interval, direction count, upper quartile, and leave-one-cluster-out summaries
non_solutions: using a public Agent outcome as a Selector feature
promoting a Runner default from public retrospective results
treating unlisted official results as missing from the denominator
changing the Agent panel or Selector rules after opening its result blobs

public_result_source.normalization: resolved is pass; no_generation, no_logs, and all other denominator Tasks are fail

agent_panel.selection_basis: checked, open model, open system, one attempt, SWE-agent mechanism
checked, open model, open system, one attempt, retriever-editor mechanism
checked, open model, open system, one attempt, Skywork-SWE mechanism

pre_outcome_exclusions.reason: result content was inspected during route feasibility and is not sealed evidence
official metadata checked flag is false
official metadata checked flag is false and model treatment is not open

rolling_origin.initial_history_adjustment: add the 0-4 Task remainder so all later Tasks form complete blocks

selectors.rule: ten most recent eligible local Tasks
round robin sorted benchmark difficulty strata, chronological within stratum

random_calibration.sampling: independent uniform ten-Task subset at every repository-local Origin

null_control.rule: permute joint Agent outcome vectors over Tasks inside each repository, preserving repository-level panel outcomes

aggregation.repository_weighting: Origins equal within repository; repositories equal in macro result

decision_rules.exploratory_nomination: candidate wide macro-repository difference is negative, every wide leave-one-cluster-out difference is negative, wide permutation as-good-or-better rate is below 0.10, and deep macro-repository direction is also negative
decision_rules.promotion: not allowed from this public retrospective study
decision_rules.later_gate: frozen independent source or strict-prospective evidence must meet the project 0.02 and interval gates

allowed_network_reads: three preregistered result blobs at the pinned official repository revision
authority.raw_result_policy: Downloaded official result files remain ignored; commit only blob identities, normalized counts, contrasts, summaries, and digests.
